effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less. If a Tamer card with the [SoC] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 1 or more memory, gain 1 memory.
